title: M7.P5: Audit post-candidate16 device and release changes
body:
## Trigger and scope

The original trigger was the ceremony gate and hosted record check 37653236199 reporting 13 completed closures after the accepted #471 audit at 2026-10-07T02:53:02.029760Z: #489, #461, #490, #491, #495, #496, #494, #498, #499, #500, #501, #502, and #504. This owns the newly due review; candidate16 common qualification and #471 remain accepted historical inputs.

Maintainer's standing requirement:
> Ensure that we've done a comprehensive code review and status review of where we are this far, where it's been getting tripped up in the VM checks, and what we need to do to get a workable build with our changes for this version.

Review the post-candidate16 P5 delta and affected interactions: ceremony accounting; storage retention and source custody; administrator dependency-scope correction; host compiler/proof repairs and ARM/FEX/device build ownership; accepted H700/SP adoption evidence; the replacement of cloud-folder migration with explicit manual setup under #508, and the UI/script/QA interactions it changes. #505 was closed not planned after the maintainer chose #508; its isolated diagnostic draft is excluded from shipped-source claims. Include #503/#506's accepted terminal firmware receipts. Do not relabel historical failures or infer personal-cloud success from local pointers.

Scope/depth: scoped Milestone delta, independent depth under code-auditor: primary plus one verified cross-lab reviewer through the Facilitator, with the required blind/refutation passes. This is not a five-seat council. External payloads must exclude ignored personal-device evidence and credentials. The user explicitly approved the two concrete safe transfers, now complete; their exact input/output and provenance records are retained.

Current state: the independent review and all four serial resolutions are complete. #524 is closed completed. The [published audit packet](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/12c599a557bcef544994fc8960a9cc3366aa4eb0/docs/audits/2026_10_08-milestone-m7-p5-delta-507) contains the frozen primary review, both verified Fable 5.1/xhigh passes, finding dispositions, direct fix evidence and a validated completion marker. Original source/criterion grades remain historical; no unresolved lead is counted as a pass. Current fixes are published through next8e8ad7c406 with ES1d76b3da7, and the exact audit artifact integration is next12c599a557bcef544994fc8960a9cc3366aa4eb0. Root and the sole auditor independently verified remote/source equality. The normal resolution lint and ceremony gate pass without the previous overdue-audit warning.

PL-001 reconciles complete tracker bodies; PL-002 retires stale QA contracts; PL-003 provides safe localized path-refusal guidance (184 cases / 4,775 assertions and44 reviewed EN/FR target outcomes); PL-004 normally rejects malformed receipt shapes (28 new and15 existing controls, with25 failures on frozen source). The UI guest/provider and scratch are retired; compact failures, logs, manifests and screenshots remain. Both approved external calls exited. Final full-record reconciliation and exact-head hosted result consumption are the remaining delivery criterion below. #508 assembled-image/public-adoption and #519 pre-device alignment remain open. No new firmware or RC is claimed.

Preserve the frozen observations. Apply fixes only in the agreed serial Phase7 remediation sequence; do not replay the accepted candidate16 VM/audit matrix merely to discharge cadence.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes for changed runtime behavior and diagnostic controls. Host compiler, storage and owner-lifecycle claims use their corresponding sealed host receipts. Already-performed physical observations are reviewed only from authorized retained evidence; no new device or personal-cloud action is part of this audit.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] The dated running log and input manifest bind the exact baseline, changed source, selected issue criteria and terminal build/proof receipts; coverage explicitly separates preserved candidate16 evidence from newly verified delta behavior.
- [x] Primary forward/retrospective findings cite code and executed evidence for the changed behaviors and interactions; every finding has a disposition and unresolved claims are not counted as passes.
- [x] Facilitator receipts verify the required cross-lab reviewer identity and both Milestone passes against the frozen safe payload; the final analysis independently verifies proposed findings.
- [x] The punch-list index, audit artifact lint and completed marker agree; fixes have affected installed/source verification and no completion is inferred from reviewer prose alone.
- [ ] M7, affected issue bodies and the canonical checkpoint record the resulting readiness and remaining publication/device gates; a fresh exact-head hosted record check consumes the completed audit honestly.


Include the full writer/filter/default-configuration interactions introduced by #520/#521 and the finite no-generic-relocation disposition recorded under #515/#510. Preserve explicit custom settings and already-written data. Final source and affected-runtime hashes are retained in the published packet; assembled firmware inclusion stays #508. This completed scope update starts no repeat audit or provider call.


## Qualified DuckStation runtime prerequisites — #522/#523

Actual GENERIC_X64 proof for #521 found the exact pinned AppImage installed mode0644; direct execution refuses with126. #522 fixes explicit package executable mode and proves original/fixed install behavior plus real target entrypoint execution. It precedes #521 screenshot runtime acceptance. Preserve the source/cache bytes and persistent saves; no guest-only chmod is a product fix. Include this input in #508 integration and #507 scope.


#522/#523 source qualification is complete: executable install and genuine target libcom_err build/install permit actual native rendering; all121 ELF/plugin closures resolve. Both default/custom captures and generated-PNG backup/restore pass. These are audited inputs, not remaining implementation jobs; final firmware inclusion stays #508.

## Acceptance evidence

1. `00-running-log.md`, input manifests and original phase1–3 records bind the frozen scope.
2. `04-analysis.md`, `05-punch-list.md` and `resolution/PL-001` through `PL-004` retain primary dispositions and direct acceptance.
3. `second-opinions/` and the external completion readback bind both approved transfers, outputs and verified provenance.
4. `audit-completion.json`, `tracker-completion.json` and resolution lint bind the four resolved findings to the closed #524 readback.
5. Root delivery records and the exact-head hosted check are pending final publication/readback; this criterion remains open until consumed.
